name: Nathan Young
notes: Known from one opinion request served at /promotions/rspwf/archive/opinion-request-nathan-young-sccw-commish-1998-08-21.html: the Las Vegas SCCW Co-Commissioner and fifteen-time former world champion, who answers Donald Vaccaro, backs the Ring Syndicate over the Powers of Arrogance and says he trained "Incredible" Idol Austin. The SCCW's own High Stakes broadcast of 25 January 1999, served on the sccw-nwc-1999 wing, calls the referee Ace Tanke his stooge.
caption: A fifteen-time former champion in the corner office of Sin City Championship Wrestling, August 1998.
